DOLL.title: Doll
DOLL.text:
A Sadida summon. Each Doll is an allied pet creature that triggers off combat events (turn start, card play, death) based on its type. Dolls can be summoned, healed, and attacked like any other creature.

When an enemy attacks, Sadida and every living Doll each take the full damage independently, soaked by their own [gold]Block[/gold]. Dolls do NOT intercept damage for Sadida (unlike Osty) — keep them alive with Block, heals, and Mend.

EXHAUST.title: Exhaust
EXHAUST.text: Removed until the end of combat.

INNATE.title: Innate
INNATE.text: Start each combat with this card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].

DOES_NOT_RECYCLE.title: Does Not Recycle
DOES_NOT_RECYCLE.text: This card summons [gold]Dolls[/gold] that do NOT return to your discard pile when they die.

RETAIN.title: Retain
RETAIN.text: Retained cards are not discarded at the end of turn.

BRAMBLE.title: Bramble
BRAMBLE.text: Whenever applied, take [blue]X[/blue] damage (Block soaks first).

ENERGY.title: Energy
ENERGY.text: Energy is used to play cards from your [gold]Hand[/gold].

RECYCLE.title: Recycle
RECYCLE.text: When this [gold]Doll[/gold] dies, this card returns to your discard pile.

WEAK.title: Weak
WEAK.text: Weakened creatures deal [blue]25%[/blue] less damage with Attacks.

STRENGTH.title: Strength
STRENGTH.text: Strength adds additional damage to Attacks.

TARGETED.title: Targeted
TARGETED.text: Your [gold]Dolls[/gold] deal 25% more damage to a Targeted enemy and redirect their random single-target attacks to it. Only one enemy can be Targeted at a time — applying it to a new enemy clears the mark from the old one. Loses 1 stack at the end of the Targeted enemy's turn.

POISON.title: Poison
POISON.text: Poisoned creatures lose HP at the start of their turn. Each turn, Poison is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
